static_traits.name: Lola
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; never received psychotherapy/counseling
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperation, willing to try structured exercises; able to self-reflect and describe triggering situations; steady tone, Positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: Repeatedly having the thought 'may never find a partner who truly loves me' because of height, increasingly overwhelming lately, affecting confidence and triggering Anxiety in social and dating situations.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these thoughts started affecting my social interactions and overall mental health. I want to deal with these insecurities and learn how to build confidence.
growth_experiences: Having been rejected by others because of height in the past, then long experiencing height-related insecurity and Self-doubt; these experiences worsened after being triggered recently, prompting Lola to assume in advance when Meeting new friends or dating that height will be an obstacle and lead to Being rejected.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of being loved
My height will cause me to be Being rejected/not truly accepted

special_situations.event: Dating someone newly met last week
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my height is seen as a problem, the other person will not want to see me again; if Being rejected it proves I am not worthy of being loved
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using positive self-talk and distraction on dates, but still Difficulty relaxing and enjoying the process
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He will not see me again, because I am too tall.

special_situations.event: Interacting with strangers at social events
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others notice my height, they will think I am not suitable and reject me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing engagement in Social situations, avoiding mentioning insecurities to reduce the risk of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think my height is a problem.

special_situations.event: Friends praising and envying my height
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive feedback does not count or is not genuine enough, unable to negate the rejection experience
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplaying, negating or ignoring praise for Self-protection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being polite, this does not count.

special_situations.event: Recalling past experiences of being rejected because of height
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once rejection happened in the past, it will repeat in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using negative memories as evidence to maintain caution and low expectations, reducing the possibility of being hurt again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It has always been like this; it will stay the same.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be truly seen and loved unconditionally in intimate relationships
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected because of height, shame and negation, self-worth shattered
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of rejection and emotional hurt by staying cautious, lowering expectations, and downplaying positive feedback

object_relations.self_representation: A tall Female easily criticized, possibly not loved

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes a more positive hypothesis or encourages a behavioral experiment (such as 'someone will appreciate your height')
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously believing positive feedback is not reliable, and will still be rejected because of height in the end (projecting past experiences onto the present)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a gentle, Empathy tone, first validating feelings, then gradually probing evidence differences; avoiding direct refutation, using open-ended questions to guide distinguishing specific situations from generalized conclusions.

manifestations: Worrying about never finding someone who truly loves oneself because of height
Anticipating rejection when meeting new people or dating
Not discussing insecurities with friends, bearing worries alone
outcomes: Declining expectations of intimate relationships and Withdrawal

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: Having a small circle of friends but not discussing height-related insecurities with them
Withdrawing the impulse to seek support back into self-soothing and endurance

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: Avoiding direct contact with insecurities through distraction
Displacing focus with positive self-talk rather than directly facing Anxiety

positive_force: Positive attitude, willing to participate in structured behavioral experiments to test beliefs
Has some self-help strategies (positive self-talk, distraction)
There are friends' positive evaluations of their height and potential support resources (though not yet fully utilized)
negative_force: Catastrophic prediction and overgeneralization (extending past rejection to the future)
Negating positive feedback and mental filtering, reinforcing negative self-schemas
Anticipating rejection in social situations leads to Anxiety and Withdrawal
Not discussing insecurities with friends, insufficient mobilization of external support

target_behavior.behavior: Significant Social anxiety and anticipating rejection when Meeting new friends or dating
antecedent: Meeting new people or entering dating scenarios
Recalling past experiences of being rejected because of height
target_behavior.core_reason: Attributing past rejection to height, forming catastrophic predictions about the future and overgeneralized cognitive patterns
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential rejection and emotional hurt, maintaining Self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: Struggling to enjoy socializing and dating, lowered confidence, further affecting Interpersonal relationships development

target_behavior.behavior: Negating positive feedback (praise and appreciation of height)
antecedent: Praise and envy from friends or others about height
target_behavior.core_reason: The negative core belief 'I am not worthy of being loved' and mental filtering make it impossible to integrate positive information
target_behavior.function: Maintains a defensive negative narrative to avoid the disappointment after expectations are shattered
target_behavior.consequence: Self-esteem difficult to improve, negative cognitions continuously consolidated, affecting intimate relationship beliefs and behaviors
